You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
ocbc_skyway | OCBC Skyway | 14 | 30 | 09:00-21:00 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
east_coast_lagoon | East Coast Lagoon Food Village | 15 | 60 | 10:30-22:30 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
night_safari | Night Safari | 56 | 180 | 19:15-24:00 | -
siloso_beach | Siloso Beach | 0 | 90 | 07:00-22:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
oceanarium: ocbc_skyway 24, haw_par_villa 23, adventure_cove 11, east_coast_lagoon 43, universal_studios 12, peranakan_museum 23, national_gallery 22, night_safari 50, siloso_beach 13
ocbc_skyway: oceanarium 24, haw_par_villa 32, adventure_cove 24, east_coast_lagoon 30, universal_studios 23, peranakan_museum 16, national_gallery 15, night_safari 48, siloso_beach 26
haw_par_villa: oceanarium 23, ocbc_skyway 32, adventure_cove 22, east_coast_lagoon 52, universal_studios 24, peranakan_museum 29, national_gallery 29, night_safari 42, siloso_beach 22
adventure_cove: oceanarium 11, ocbc_skyway 24, haw_par_villa 22, east_coast_lagoon 44, universal_studios 12, peranakan_museum 23, national_gallery 23, night_safari 50, siloso_beach 12
east_coast_lagoon: oceanarium 43, ocbc_skyway 30, haw_par_villa 52, adventure_cove 44, universal_studios 43, peranakan_museum 33, national_gallery 33, night_safari 57, siloso_beach 46
universal_studios: oceanarium 12, ocbc_skyway 23, haw_par_villa 24, adventure_cove 12, east_coast_lagoon 43, peranakan_museum 23, national_gallery 23, night_safari 51, siloso_beach 13
peranakan_museum: oceanarium 23, ocbc_skyway 16, haw_par_villa 29, adventure_cove 23, east_coast_lagoon 33, universal_studios 23, national_gallery 12, night_safari 44, siloso_beach 25
national_gallery: oceanarium 22, ocbc_skyway 15, haw_par_villa 29, adventure_cove 23, east_coast_lagoon 33, universal_studios 23, peranakan_museum 12, night_safari 45, siloso_beach 25
night_safari: oceanarium 50, ocbc_skyway 48, haw_par_villa 42, adventure_cove 50, east_coast_lagoon 57, universal_studios 51, peranakan_museum 44, national_gallery 45, siloso_beach 50
siloso_beach: oceanarium 13, ocbc_skyway 26, haw_par_villa 22, adventure_cove 12, east_coast_lagoon 46, universal_studios 13, peranakan_museum 25, national_gallery 25, night_safari 50

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Hey, I’ve got 14 hours and 55 minutes for a trip starting at 09:00 with a budget of S$104. I definitely want to hit up Night Safari (gotta be there between 19:15 and 22:15), and I need to make sure I do Haw Par Villa before that. Also, I’m planning to spend 450 minutes at Universal Studios Singapore and 120 minutes at Peranakan Museum. If there's any time left, I’d love to squeeze in Singapore Oceanarium, OCBC Skyway, Adventure Cove Waterpark, East Coast Lagoon Food Village, National Gallery Singapore, and Siloso Beach too.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Create Z3 solver
s = Solver()

# Time limits: Start at 09:00 (540), duration 14h 55m -> End by 540 + 895 = 1435 (23:55)
START_DAY = 540
END_DAY = 1435
BUDGET = 104

# Locations data
places = {
    "oceanarium": {"cost": 50, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "ocbc_skyway": {"cost": 14, "dur": 30, "open": 540, "close": 1260},
    "haw_par_villa": {"cost": 0, "dur": 90, "open": 540, "close": 1200},
    "adventure_cove": {"cost": 40, "dur": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1020},
    "east_coast_lagoon": {"cost": 15, "dur": 60, "open": 630, "close": 1350},
    "universal_studios": {"cost": 83, "dur": 450, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "peranakan_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "national_gallery": {"cost": 25, "dur": 150, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "night_safari": {"cost": 56, "dur": 180, "open": 1155, "close": 1440},
    "siloso_beach": {"cost": 0, "dur": 90, "open": 420, "close": 1320},
}

travel_times = {
    "oceanarium": {"ocbc_skyway": 24, "haw_par_villa": 23, "adventure_cove": 11, "east_coast_lagoon": 43, "universal_studios": 12, "peranakan_museum": 23, "national_gallery": 22, "night_safari": 50, "siloso_beach": 13},
    "ocbc_skyway": {"oceanarium": 24, "haw_par_villa": 32, "adventure_cove": 24, "east_coast_lagoon": 30, "universal_studios": 23, "peranakan_museum": 16, "national_gallery": 15, "night_safari": 48, "siloso_beach": 26},
    "haw_par_villa": {"oceanarium": 23, "ocbc_skyway": 32, "adventure_cove": 22, "east_coast_lagoon": 52, "universal_studios": 24, "peranakan_museum": 29, "national_gallery": 29, "night_safari": 42, "siloso_beach": 22},
    "adventure_cove": {"oceanarium": 11, "ocbc_skyway": 24, "haw_par_villa": 22, "east_coast_lagoon": 44, "universal_studios": 12, "peranakan_museum": 23, "national_gallery": 23, "night_safari": 50, "siloso_beach": 12},
    "east_coast_lagoon": {"oceanarium": 43, "ocbc_skyway": 30, "haw_par_villa": 52, "adventure_cove": 44, "universal_studios": 43, "peranakan_museum": 33, "national_gallery": 33, "night_safari": 57, "siloso_beach": 46},
    "universal_studios": {"oceanarium": 12, "ocbc_skyway": 23, "haw_par_villa": 24, "adventure_cove": 12, "east_coast_lagoon": 43, "peranakan_museum": 23, "national_gallery": 23, "night_safari": 51, "siloso_beach": 13},
    "peranakan_museum": {"oceanarium": 23, "ocbc_skyway": 16, "haw_par_villa": 29, "adventure_cove": 23, "east_coast_lagoon": 33, "universal_studios": 23, "national_gallery": 12, "night_safari": 44, "siloso_beach": 25},
    "national_gallery": {"oceanarium": 22, "ocbc_skyway": 15, "haw_par_villa": 29, "adventure_cove": 23, "east_coast_lagoon": 33, "universal_studios": 23, "peranakan_museum": 12, "night_safari": 45, "siloso_beach": 25},
    "night_safari": {"oceanarium": 50, "ocbc_skyway": 48, "haw_par_villa": 42, "adventure_cove": 50, "east_coast_lagoon": 57, "universal_studios": 51, "peranakan_museum": 44, "national_gallery": 45, "siloso_beach": 50},
    "siloso_beach": {"oceanarium": 13, "ocbc_skyway": 26, "haw_par_villa": 22, "adventure_cove": 12, "east_coast_lagoon": 46, "universal_studios": 13, "peranakan_museum": 25, "national_gallery": 25, "night_safari": 50},
}

# Decision variables
visited = {pid: Bool(f"visited_{pid}") for pid in places}
start_time = {pid: Int(f"start_{pid}") for pid in places}
end_time = {pid: Int(f"end_{pid}") for pid in places}

# Must-visit places: night_safari, haw_par_villa, universal_studios, peranakan_museum
s.add(visited["night_safari"])
s.add(visited["haw_par_villa"])
s.add(visited["universal_studios"])
s.add(visited["peranakan_museum"])

# Budget constraint
s.add(Sum([If(visited[pid], places[pid]["cost"], 0) for pid in places]) <= BUDGET)

# Night Safari specific window: 19:15 (1155) to 22:15 (1335)
s.add(start_time["night_safari"] >= 1155)
s.add(start_time["night_safari"] <= 1335)

# Haw Par Villa before Night Safari
s.add(end_time["haw_par_villa"] <= start_time["night_safari"])

for pid, p in places.items():
    dur = p["dur"]
    op = p["open"]
    cl = p["close"]
    
    # Time bounds if visited
    s.add(Implies(visited[pid], And(
        start_time[pid] >= START_DAY,
        start_time[pid] >= op,
        end_time[pid] == start_time[pid] + dur,
        end_time[pid] <= cl,
        end_time[pid] <= END_DAY
    )))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints
place_list = list(places.keys())
for i in range(len(place_list)):
    for j in range(len(place_list)):
        if i != j:
            p1 = place_list[i]
            p2 = place_list[j]
            t_travel = travel_times[p1][p2]
            # If both visited and p1 finishes before p2 starts, account for travel time
            s.add(Implies(
                And(visited[p1], visited[p2], end_time[p1] <= start_time[p2]),
                start_time[p2] >= end_time[p1] + t_travel
            ))
            s.add(Implies(
                And(visited[p1], visited[p2], end_time[p2] <= start_time[p1]),
                start_time[p1] >= end_time[p2] + t_travel
            ))

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for pid in places:
        if is_true(m[visited[pid]]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": pid,
                "start": m[start_time[pid]].as_long(),
                "end": m[end_time[pid]].as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
